rationale: B01 reports 297/596 leaves with fair_value, but the raw SOI layout intentionally has paired monetary columns: Cost / Amortized Cost and Fair Value. Representative position rows carry both cost and fair value, and the March 31, 2026 SOI fair-value total of 1,153,413,327 ties to the balance-sheet total investments at fair value. The low fraction is therefore caused by the rule counting cost/amortized-cost leaves in the denominator, not by missing fair-value data.
